data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC). Root cause identified: report_schema_drift() in invariants.py has no alert_store dedup check. The function fires subprocess.run() unconditionally on every call, unlike check_at_most_one_dso_local_id() which properly calls alert_store.is_deduped() before filing. When the _DUAL_IDENTITY_CAP_PER_PASS is hit during check_dual_identity_complete(), report_schema_drift() is called with a local key like 'L-16' and observed={}/expected={'invariants-cap-hit': True} - but every reconciler pass that hits the cap fires a NEW bug ticket because there's no dedup gate. This produced 12+ duplicate tickets.
